name: LEGOBench
description: LEGOBench is a benchmark for evaluating systems that generate scientific leaderboards, curated from 22 years of arXiv preprint data and over 11k machine learning leaderboards from PapersWithCode, featuring graph-based and language model-based leaderboard generation tasks.
reputation: A niche but useful benchmark for scientific leaderboard generation, mainly of interest to researchers working on structured information extraction and scientific meta-analysis.
notes: Includes multiple task configurations for leaderboard generation; evaluates encoder-only and decoder-only scientific language models.
